events.title: Southwest Gas Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Decline Y/Y
events.body: SWX beat Q1 earnings estimates as operating income rises, though revenues and system throughput decline from last year.

events.title: ONE Gas Q1 Earnings & Revenues Miss Estimates, Sales Decline Y/Y
events.body: OGS misses Q1 earnings and revenue estimates as sales and natural gas volumes decline year over year despite higher operating income.

events.title: ONE Gas (OGS) Lags Q1 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
events.body: ONE Gas (OGS) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -0.79% and -13.18%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Powering Up: UGI Banks $685M in Strategic Turnaround
events.body: UGI Corporation is divesting non-core assets to strengthen its balance sheet and sharpen its focus on its primary natural gas and propane distribution.
